title: High Speed Rail Planning Authority Bill 2017
short_title: High Speed Rail Planning Authority Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would establish a High Speed Rail Planning Authority to plan and develop an east coast rail system and reserve land for its corridor.
Its 11 part-time members would include ministerial appointees and nominees from relevant state and territory governments, local government and the rail industry, serving three-year terms.
Commencement would depend on an appropriation for the authority, with the Act starting the day after the Consolidated Revenue Fund is appropriated for its payment.
changes: The authority's functions would include land use planning and measures to reduce environmental impacts.
It would have a duty to consult interested organisations and the public about high speed rail matters.
The minister could request reports and information about the authority's work.
summary.affected: Interested organisations and members of the public consulted on high speed rail matters would be affected.
